capabilities.name: PACED_MOVEMENT_V1
capabilities.owner_decision: CONDITIONS-0 §4.3 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_CONDITIONS0_ACTOR_CONDITIONS_DECISION_2026-09-30.md, as amended by CREATURE-AI-0 §5.1); number allocated by the #1622 control plane and registered by SPEED-1; result field step_wait_ms by the owner's acceptance of OQ-1 (CLIENT-COMPLETION R1), registered by STEP-PACE-WIRE-0
capabilities.owner: current ChannelRuntime (Movement owner step pacing)
capabilities.offer_gate: SPEED-1: offered. It extends the result of command type 1 with STEP_DISPOSITION_TOO_EARLY = 4 and owns no command type or domain. Every player step is paced whether or not it is selected: one early step waits in a one-step buffer, and a second early request is TOO_EARLY with this capability selected and REJECTED without it. STEP-PACE-WIRE-0: the result also carries step_wait_ms (field 2), the pacing receipt: on MOVED the duration of the step just committed (a multiple of 50 ms, 50 to 111,150), on TOO_EARLY the milliseconds left until the server deadline, rounded up (1 to 111,150), never on BLOCKED or REJECTED. It is written only when non-zero, and it is not state (no revision, no snapshot). Without this capability selected, field 2 fails closed and the command type 1 result is at most 4 bytes; the command type 1 max_result_payload_bytes is the bound under this capability.

capabilities.name: WORLD_LIGHT_V1
capabilities.owner_decision: WORLD-INTERACTION-0 §10.2 and §11 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_WORLD_INTERACTION0_DOORS_LEVERS_FIELDS_AND_WORLD_CLOCK_DECISION_2026-10-01.md, owner answer 7a); number leased to LOOP-CLOCK-1 by the #1622 control plane

With it selected, domain 18 is sent as a snapshot at admission, reconnect and channel transfer at the session's current revision and as a delta on a light change or a new Tibian hour, at most one per 10,000 ms (WORLDINT0-RL-18), read at the node's UTC time fact against the World clock epoch, which is the Unix epoch (a whole UTC hour) until a World ruleset carries world_clock_epoch_utc_ms; and the domain 1 type 2 player and creature entries carry the VIS-2 light (fields 11-12, at most 6 bytes, WORLDINT0-RL-20), changed on the wire at most once per 1,000 ms per entity. A player's light is its current LIGHT condition; equipped items and monster content carry no light source yet. Without it selected, domain 18 and fields 11-12 are never sent and the client renders a fixed day light.

capabilities.name: LOGOUT_V1
capabilities.owner_decision: ARCH-KILL-REWARD-LOGOUT-1 §1.6 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_ARCH_KILL_REWARD_LOGOUT_PACKETS_2026-10-04.md); the proposed capability 19 was already WORLD_LIGHT_V1 and 20 is leased to CONNECTION_TRACE_V1 (D770), so LOGOUT-WIRE-1 registers the next free capability, 21, with the proposed command type 23; numbers leased to LOGOUT-WIRE-1 by the #1622 control plane
capabilities.owner: current ChannelRuntime (the in-fight deadline) and the GameSession terminal release (session_state = 3)
capabilities.offer_gate: Offered by LOGOUT-WIRE-1 in every offered set (production, Item view and bundle World). With it selected, command type 23 is answered with one LogoutResultV1: IN_FIGHT with retry_after_ms while the actor's in-fight deadline runs (ATTACK0-RL-03), BUSY while a durable spell commit or an own kill settlement is pending or when the terminal release failed retryably before it committed, and ACCEPTED only after the terminal release (session_state = 3 with the final position write) has committed, after which the transport closes cleanly. At most one logout is outstanding per GameSession (LOGOUT-RL-01); a second one before the first result is a protocol error. Without it selected, command type 23 is refused as an unregistered command.

The rate slot is spent before decoding; over-rate commands return Accepted Refused(RateLimited). Malformed payloads and commands without capability 28 are Rejected with an empty payload.
